races.name: Human
races.description: Short-lived but driven. Learn fast and raise big families.

races.name: Elf
races.description: Live for centuries; graceful and magical, but frail and slow to learn.

races.name: Dwarf
races.description: Long-lived and stubborn as stone. Tough, strong, slow on their feet.

races.name: Orc
races.description: Brief, fierce lives. Huge strength and fast learners in battle.

races.name: Halfling
races.description: Nimble, lucky and longer-lived than humans.

races.name: Gnome
races.description: Brilliant tinkerers with deep mana and very long lives.

races.name: Dragonborn
races.description: Scaled descendants of dragons: strong in body and spell, fire-proof.

races.name: Beastkin
races.description: Wild hunters with sharp reflexes. Short lives, large litters.

races.name: Half-Elf
races.description: Born of human and elf: long-lived and adaptable.

races.name: Half-Orc
races.description: Born of human and orc: strong, driven, a little longer-lived than orcs.

races.name: Half-Dragon
races.description: Born of human and dragonborn: a thinner draconic gift.
